source.name: MLB.com / Arizona Diamondbacks: Arizona Diamondbacks and Avnet announce new partnership to include first ever jersey patch
source.quote: The Arizona Diamondbacks have entered a multi-year partnership with Avnet that will include the company's "A" and name on the sleeve of the D-backs' jerseys beginning with the 2023 season

note: Jersey patch (sleeve). Multi-year partnership announced 2023-02-02; no figure disclosed.
